info.name: GoGrocer API
info.description:
# GoGrocer — Multi-vendor Grocery Delivery API

Complete collection of all **189 endpoints** across the three mobile apps, generated from `routes/api.php`.

| App | Prefix | Auth |
|---|---|---|
| 🛒 User App | `/api/...` | Public + Bearer token (Laravel Passport) |
| 🏪 Store App | `/api/store/...` | None — identifies via `store_id` in body |
| 🛵 Driver App | `/api/driver/...` | None — identifies via `dboy_id` in body |

## Getting started
1. Set `base_url` (defaults to `https://anythingalltime.com/api`).
2. Call **User App API → Auth & Account → Login** (or *Login With Email*). A test script auto-saves `token` into `user_token` and the user id into `user_id`.
3. All 🔒 user endpoints then work automatically via collection-level Bearer auth.
4. For Store/Driver folders fill `store_id` / `driver_id` variables.

## Conventions
- Bodies are `x-www-form-urlencoded` (or `form-data` when a file upload is involved).
- Params marked **REQUIRED** come from server-side validation rules; the rest are read by the controller and usually expected.
- Typical response envelope: `{ "status": "1|0", "message": "...", "data": ... }`.
